newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PDCP soars 18 pct on merger plan news.
newsitem.headline: PDCP soars 18 pct on merger plan news.

text.p: PDCP Development Bank rose by 4.50 pesos, or 18 percent, to 29.50 pesos on Thursday after it announced a merger plan with AsianBank, brokers said.
"Investors are taking a second look at PDCP Bank. The current market price is lower than the book value," Ramon Borja, an analyst at Dharmala Securities, said.
The stock went up to a record high of 32 pesos immediately after the announcement, and retreated to 29.50 by midsession.

Major shareholders of PDCP and AsianBank announced they had signed a memorandum of understanding to pursue a merger plan. The statement did not say which bank will be the surviving entity and it did not give a timetable for the plan.
Other bank stocks were also on the rise following the favourable ratings by Standard and Poor's Rating Agency.
The Bank of the Philippine Islands inched up by three pesos to 159 pesos and Philippine National Bank added 2.50 pesos to 327.50 pesos.
